single_capture_operating_point.applies_to: motor_infer, and node.conf pool_windows = 1 — anything scoring ONE unpooled capture

warning: `threshold` assumes pool_windows = 10. The ring medians FEATURES, so the score distribution changes shape with ring depth: the ring threshold applied to a single capture flags ~30 % of healthy ones. Use threshold_single_capture for unpooled scoring, and re-run rig_node_refit.py with a matching POOL for any other ring depth.
